description: Land Acquisition - Imayanan west, Wadamarachchi South D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific land described in detail (including location, boundaries, and extent) is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. It deals primarily with land acquisition and property matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). While it mentions a Minister by name, this is incidental to the land-related declaration rather than being the primary focus of the gazette.
